definitions.explanation: One of the two eyes, used when referring to closing one eye, losing sight in one eye, or something affecting only one side.

examples.japanese: {片目|かため}で{覗|のぞ}くと{立体感|りったいかん}がなくなる。
examples.english: If you look with one eye, you lose the sense of depth.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}で{片目|かため}の{視力|しりょく}を{失|うしな}ったが、{前向|まえむ}きに{生活|せいかつ}している。
examples.english: I lost sight in one eye in an accident, but I'm living positively.

notes:
Composed of {片|かた} (one of a pair) + {目|め} (eye). The prefix {片|かた} is used for one of a pair of body parts or objects: {片手|かたて} (one hand), {片足|かたあし} (one foot/leg), {片耳|かたみみ} (one ear).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {片目|かため}をつぶる: to close one eye (also means to overlook)
- {片目|かため}で{見|み}る: to look with one eye
- {片目|かため}を{失|うしな}う: to lose one eye
- {片目|かため}を{閉|と}じる: to close one eye

RELATED TERMS:
- {片手|かたて}: one hand
- {片足|かたあし}: one foot/leg
- {片耳|かたみみ}: one ear
- {両目|りょうめ}: both eyes — the counterpart
